summary: American Battery Materials filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to outstanding promissory and convertible notes, extending maturities to November 30, 2026. If the NYSE American uplist is not consummated by that date, principal automatically rises 15% from June 30, 2026 balances, a $1,489,217 increase, and the company must issue 779,901 commitment shares (including 612,476 previously agreed). Shares are issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D within ten business days. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch the uplist deadline, potential dilution and default risk if the listing slips.
